wills.definition: Form of will (plural): One's independent faculty of choice; the ability to be able to exercise one's choice or intention.

wilt.definition: Form of will (archaic indicative present second-person singular): Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

wind.definition: Real or perceived movement of atmospheric air usually caused by convection or differences in air pressure.

winds.definition: Form of wind (plural): Real or perceived movement of atmospheric air usually caused by convection or differences in air pressure.

wine.definition: An alcoholic beverage made by fermenting grape juice, with an ABV ranging from 5.5–16%.

wing.definition: An appendage of an animal's (bird, bat, insect) body that enables it to fly.

wingless.definition: Having no, or only rudimentary, wings.

wings.definition: Form of wing (plural): An appendage of an animal's (bird, bat, insect) body that enables it to fly.

wisdom.definition: An element of personal character that enables one to distinguish the wise from the unwise.

wise.definition: Showing good judgement or the benefit of experience.

with.definition: Form of withe (alternative): A flexible, slender shoot or twig, especially when used as a band or for binding; a withy.

withal.definition: Together with the rest; besides; in addition.

within.definition: In or into the interior; inside.

witness.definition: Attestation of a fact or event; testimony.

witnesses.definition: Form of witness (plural): Attestation of a fact or event; testimony.

witnesseth.definition: Form of witness (archaic indicative present singular third-person): To furnish proof of, to show.

wives.definition: Form of wife (plural): A married woman, especially in relation to her spouse.

woe.definition: Great sadness or distress; a misfortune causing such sadness.

womb.definition: In female mammals, the organ in which the young are conceived and grow until birth; the uterus.

women.definition: Form of woman (plural): An adult female human.

won.definition: Form of win (participle past): To conquer, defeat.

wooing.definition: Form of woo (gerund participle present): To endeavor to gain someone's affection or support.

wool.definition: The hair of the sheep, llama and some other ruminants.

word.definition: The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)

words.definition: Form of word (plural): The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)

work.definition: To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

working.definition: Form of work (gerund participle present): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

world.definition: The subjective human experience, regarded collectively; human collective existence; existence in general; the reality we live in.

world’s.definition: The subjective human experience, regarded collectively; human collective existence; existence in general; the reality we live in.

worms.definition: Form of worm (plural): A generally tubular invertebrate of the annelid phylum; an earthworm.

worn.definition: Form of wear (participle past): To have on.

worship.definition: To reverence (a deity, etc.) with supreme respect and veneration; to perform religious exercises in honour of.

worshipper.definition: A person who worships, especially at a place of assembly for religious services.

worshippers.definition: Form of worshipper (plural): A person who worships, especially at a place of assembly for religious services.

worships.definition: Form of worship (indicative present singular third-person): To reverence (a deity, etc.) with supreme respect and veneration; to perform religious exercises in honour of.

wot.definition: Form of wit (first-person indicative present singular): To know, be aware of (constructed with of when used intransitively).

would.definition: Past tense of will; usually followed by a bare infinitive.

wouldst.definition: Form of will (archaic indicative past second-person singular): Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

wound.definition: Form of wind (participle past): To blow air through a wind instrument or horn to make a sound.

wounded.definition: Form of wound (participle past): To hurt or injure (someone) by cutting, piercing, or tearing the skin.

woven.definition: Form of weave (participle past): To form something by passing lengths or strands of material over and under one another.

wrath.definition: Great anger; (countable) an instance of this.

wrathful.definition: Possessed of great wrath; very angry.

wreathed.definition: Form of wreath (participle past): Form of wreathe (alternative): Senses relating to intertwining or twisting.

wrecked.definition: Form of wreck (participle past): To destroy violently; to cause severe damage to something, to a point where it no longer works, or is useless.

wretch.definition: An unhappy, unfortunate, or miserable person.

wronged.definition: Form of wrong (participle past): To treat unjustly; to injure or harm; to do wrong by.

wrongs.definition: Form of wrong (plural): Something that is immoral or not good.

wrought.definition: Form of work (archaic participle past rare): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

yard.definition: A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.

yard-arm.definition: Form of yardarm (alternative): The outer end of a yard, often equipped with blocks for reeving signal halyards.

ye.definition: The Cyrillic letter Е, е, featured in various Slavic and Turkic languages.

year.definition: Form of here (pronunciation-spelling): This place; this location.

yearns.definition: Form of yearn (indicative present singular third-person): To have a strong desire for something or to do something; to long for or to do something.

years.definition: Form of year (plural): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

yes.definition: An affirmative expression; an answer that shows agreement or acceptance.

yet.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

yield.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yoke.definition: Form of yolk (misspelling): The yellow, spherical part of an egg that is surrounded by the white albumen, and serves as nutriment for the growing young.

yonder.definition: At or in a distant but indicated place.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: Offspring, especially the immature offspring of animals.

younger.definition: Form of young (comparative): In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.
